name: Raspberry Pi OS
description: Raspberry Pi OS is the official Linux-based operating system for Raspberry Pi single-board computers, maintained by the Raspberry Pi Foundation in Cambridge, UK. Based on Debian, it provides a beginner-friendly desktop and CLI environment, built and distributed through pi-gen, the open-source image build system.

owner.name: Raspberry Pi Foundation
owner.description: UK charity based in Cambridge developing low-cost computers and open-source educational software.
